root_cause: In parse/__init__.py, the Parser._handle_field method handles datetime format specifiers like %z via the dt_format_to_regex branch but does not advance self._group_index by the number of capturing groups introduced by the generated regex pattern for %z. This causes later fields to read from the wrong capture groups, so the second field returns '00' instead of the expected 'abc'.
